description: An offline AI-powered desk companion robot unit that translates natural language commands using a local LLM into motor movements, facial eye expressions, and interactive OLED scene animations (such as dancing stickmen or walking off screen) on an ESP32 via WebSockets, with dedicated AP-mode UDP camera streaming from an ESP32-CAM.

packages.config.py: Centralized system configuration defining network defaults, hardware IPs, Ollama LLM parameters, audio settings, and streaming latency targets.
packages.connection.py: ConnectionManager class implementing a deterministic connection state machine (DISCONNECTED -> CONFIG_LOADING -> HARDWARE_PROBING -> CONNECTING -> VERIFYING -> READY -> DEGRADED), non-blocking TCP probing, Wi-Fi interface discovery, and fault isolation across Robot Body (port 81), ESP32-CAM (ports 2222/2223), and Ollama LLM (port 11434).

audio.service.py: AudioService class managing Chatterbox TTS and Edge-TTS fallback, unique timestamped WAV chunk generation, dual output (/audio/ relative HTTP static route and local PC winsound), and 44.1kHz 16-bit Stereo PCM WAV resampling.
audio.voices: Directory storing zero-shot custom cloned voice prompt audio files (24kHz mono 16-bit PCM WAV) for Chatterbox TTS.

chat.engine.py: ChatEngine class managing Ollama LLM conversation history and querying with qwen2.5:1.5b (414ms first token latency), sliding-window history pruning, JSON fallback, and ask_stream streaming generator for sub-second response latency.
chat.prompts.py: System prompt, robot identity with strict 'Ikru' name capitalization rule, mandatory pairing of emotional shifts with vocal paralinguistic sound tags, mandatory leading OLED emotion tags, OLED emotion rules, and movement tool instructions.
chat.parser.py: Extracts OLED facial expression [emotion] tags, recovers top-level JSON emotion fields, parses tool calls from LLM JSON responses, and exposes StreamSentenceParser for incremental sentence boundary parsing.

vision.receiver.py: VisionReceiver class handling AP discovery handshake (port 2223) and reassembling 22-byte header UDP packets into frames (port 2222).
vision.frame_buffer.py: Thread-safe latest-frame buffer with zero queue buildup.
vision.vlm.py: VLMClient for on-demand visual reasoning with Qwen3-VL/LLaVA.

autonomy.brain.py: AutonomousBrain class managing background curiosity, random exploration, vision object identification, self-directed questioning, and idle state transitions.
autonomy.locomotion.py: Autonomous locomotion controller for obstacle avoidance, wandering, and target tracking.
autonomy.world_model.py: Maintains spatial representation of surrounding objects and obstacles.

memory.database.py: SQLite database storage for short-term facts, conversation logs, and interaction history.
memory.vector_store.py: Qdrant vector store integration for semantic long-term memory retrieval.
memory.manager.py: MemoryManager coordinating SQLite fact extraction and Qdrant semantic search context injection.

net.discovery.py: UDP/TCP network discovery and automatic ESP32 body & camera IP detection.
net.bringup.py: Automated network bring-up, Wi-Fi provisioning, and hardware reachability verification.
net.netinfo.py: Active network configuration and IP route resolution utilities.

mic.controller.py: MicController class handling PyAudio/SpeechRecognition initialization, ambient noise calibration, safe ASCII prompt rendering, and Google Speech-to-Text.
mic.vad.py: Voice Activity Detection (VAD) segmenter for stream audio gating.

chat.engine.py: ChatEngine class managing Ollama LLM conversation history and querying with qwen2.5:3b/1.5b, sliding-window history pruning, JSON fallback, persistent MemoryManager context injection, and ask_stream streaming generator for sub-second response latency.
chat.prompts.py: System prompt, robot identity with strict 'Ikru' name capitalization rule, mandatory pairing of emotional shifts with vocal paralinguistic sound tags, mandatory leading OLED emotion tags, OLED emotion rules, and movement tool instructions.
chat.parser.py: Extracts OLED facial expression [emotion] tags, recovers top-level JSON emotion fields, parses tool calls from LLM JSON responses, and exposes StreamSentenceParser for incremental sentence boundary parsing.
chat.tool_router.py: Natural language action intent router mapping user prompts to robot movement, emotion sequences, or VLM vision queries.

robot.controller.py: RobotController WebSocket client managing connection to ws://{ip}:81 with keep-alive pings, candidate failover, background auto-reconnect, motor movements, ultrasonic distance queries, emergency obstacle brake, R2-D2 sound sweeps, full-screen OLED animated eye expressions, and I2S audio playback synchronization.
robot.protocol.py: Command strings, constants, and scroll timing calculations.
robot.idle.py: Idle state behavior generator (yawning, looking around, blinking).
robot.proximity.py: Ultrasonic proximity alert monitor and reactive behavior handler.
robot.sequences.py: SequenceRunner for playing multi-modal recorded emotion sequences (e.g. celebrate).

ui.server.py: Lightweight HTTP server serving the IKRU professional UI, REST API (/api/status, /api/scan, /api/network/info, /api/chat/stream, /api/robot/command, /api/audio/test, /api/audio/volume, /api/camera/stream, /api/camera/frame, /api/camera/status, /api/vision/observe, /api/wifi/scan, /api/wifi/configure, /api/voice/upload), integrating ChatEngine with SSE streaming, refined visual intent keywords, connection state machine health checks, master volume scaling, multi-stage audio decoder (soundfile, librosa, scipy, torchaudio, pydub), and live ESP32-CAM UDP proxy.

static.index.html: Professional minimal HTML5 layout featuring the ~1.5s geometric IKRU logo boot experience, header volume slider pill with mute toggle, Wi-Fi Provisioning card, live onboard camera viewport, live OLED eye emulator, Talk to Ikru conversational dialogue panel with sub-second voice streaming, reset memory button, microphone dictation, zero-shot voice cloning studio, and kinematics dpad.
static.style.css: Apple-grade off-white (#F8F9FA) CSS design system, hairline blueprint construction lines, Space Grotesk & JetBrains Mono typography, conversational chat bubble styling, and CSS keyframe animations.
static.app.js: Vanilla JS controller managing boot sequence state transitions, real-time WebSocket telemetry polling, EventSource SSE chat streaming (sendChatMessage), master volume adjustments, dynamic Wi-Fi network scanning, browser WebAudio AudioBuffer to 24kHz 16-bit PCM WAV conversion for zero-shot voice cloning, and speech synthesis.

software.main.py: Main CLI terminal loop integrating ChatEngine, RobotController, VisionReceiver, MicController, and AudioService.
software.run_dashboard.py: Convenience launcher script for the IKRU professional companion web dashboard on port 5000.

connection_sequence: 2. Confirm PC is on local WiFi GNXS-2.4G-C457E1
3. Read assigned IP address from ESP32 Body OLED screen
6. Enter OLED IP into dashboard header and click REFRESH

controller.purpose: ESP32 Body & OLED firmware managing WebSocket server (port 81), MAX98357A I2S natural voice streaming on Core 0 with dynamic digital volume scaling (VOLUME:<0-100>), DRV8833 dual motors (remapped to GPIO 18/19), full-screen eye animations, non-volatile Wi-Fi storage via Preferences (NVS), dynamic Wi-Fi switching routine (applyNewWiFi), non-blocking SoftAP fallback ('IKRU-SETUP' / 192.168.4.1) when connection fails, and SET_WIFI:<ssid>:<pass> command handling over both WebSocket and USB Serial.

head.purpose: ESP32-CAM Head Unit ('IKRU-CAM' / 192.168.4.1) firmware streaming UDP video on port 2222 with discovery on port 2223 and configurable OV2640 orientation controls (CAMERA_VFLIP/CAMERA_HMIRROR).

audio.esp32_test_receiver.ino: Standalone ESP32 I2S WAV streaming firmware (MAX98357A on GPIO 25/26/27, 44.1kHz stereo 16-bit).
audio.test_audio_server.py: Local HTTP audio server (port 8000) with edge-tts speech synthesis and 44.1kHz stereo WAV resampling.
audio.test_tts_comparison.py: Interactive TTS expressiveness and accent comparison suite evaluating Chatterbox-Nano (paralinguistic tags like [chuckle], [laugh], [sigh], [gasp]) and Edge-TTS regional accents (US, UK, Australian, Indian) with local PC playback and optional streaming to the ESP32 robot speaker.
audio.generate_expressive_audios.py: Showcase test script generating and validating 7 expressive human paralinguistic audio files ([laughter], [giggle], [sigh], [clear_throat], [gasp], [cry], [whisper]) using Chatterbox TTS with exact vocabulary token alignment, 44.1kHz 16-bit stereo PCM WAV output, and local PC speaker playback.
audio.output: Directory holding generated expressive 44.1kHz 16-bit stereo PCM WAV showcase samples.

vision.test_udp_receiver.py: Standalone UDP test receiver with MobileNet-SSD object detection. Dynamic path resolution ensures models/MobileNetSSD_deploy.prototxt and caffemodel are loaded correctly regardless of working directory.
vision.test_udp_receiver_yolo.py: Standalone UDP test receiver with real-time YOLOv8 object detection (ultralytics integration, configurable confidence, image size, and device set to 'cpu' by default to prevent torchvision CUDA NMS kernel mismatches).

mic.test_mic_stt.py: Microphone enumeration, PyAudio hardware test, and Google Web Speech API speech-to-text trial.

docs.purpose: Comprehensive system documentation, architecture specifications, interactive HTML diagrams, and operational guides.

files.HOW_IKRU_WORKS.md: In-depth architecture specification and component interaction manual for IKRU.
files.README.md: High-level overview and quick-start documentation for the IKRU project.
files.diagrams: Interactive HTML/JSON diagrams covering system architecture, use case, class structure, activity, sequence, and DFD levels 1-3.
